name: Tori
bio: Hi I'm Tori, Founder and Director of Time Specialist Support. My background is in Speech and Language Therapy and I first started learning about autism when I was studying at university.

name: Ally
bio: I joined Time in July 2016 as the Service Manager. Every day is different, and I get to meet, talk to, and support lots of fabulous staff and families while trying to give the best service possible.

name: Jack
bio: Hi, I'm Jack and I am the Recruitment Co-ordinator at Time Specialist Support. I want to help make the Time support worker team even stronger.

name: Richard
bio: I've been working for TSS for over 10 years and now work in the office full-time, bringing frontline understanding into service coordination.

name: Aabhya
bio: I've just completed my Psychology degree and I'm passionate about supporting neurodivergent individuals in ways that feel empowering, respectful, and fun.
